title: Senior Product Manager
description:
SecureFinance Ltd. is a UK-based fintech company building compliance and regulatory reporting tools for financial institutions. We are hiring a Senior PM to own our core compliance product.

This role is based at our London headquarters. Candidates must be eligible to work in the United Kingdom — we do not provide work visa sponsorship. This is an onsite role; remote work is not available.

Requirements:
- 6+ years of product management experience
- Right to work in the UK (no sponsorship available)
- Based in or willing to relocate to London — this role is fully onsite
- Experience in financial services, regtech, or compliance software strongly preferred
- Familiarity with FCA regulations and UK financial compliance landscape

Responsibilities:
- Own the roadmap for our core compliance reporting suite
- Work with enterprise banking and insurance clients to understand regulatory requirements
- Partner with engineering on technical compliance architecture
- Navigate relationships with legal and compliance stakeholders

This role requires candidates who can be in the London office Monday through Friday. No exceptions on remote or hybrid arrangements.
